`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, ranked by severity:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — unauthenticated `/internal/metrics` and `/internal/flush-cache` (VPN removed in the 4.0 migration, auth was never added back)
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL built by string concatenation in `runSavedReport`, unparameterized filter injection point (not currently wired to a route, but built against user-controlled input)
3. **`config/staging.js`** — real plaintext DB password committed to source
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` pinned at `1.4.2`, the version NOTES.md says was yanked for a prototype-pollution report; `1.4.3` is the fix

I ran the repo's own `verify.js` check afterward as a sanity check — it passed, confirming all four are named with the right files and the service code itself wasn't touched.
